additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434317-DC/Si-D/PT- [MP/SO170003508] Want to know reason for black screen CRM:02919000050
additional_info.body:
Dear Rangel Cecconi,
Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention. We understand your concern regarding the charger displaying a black screen.
After reviewing the official Siemens service and troubleshooting documentation, here are the key insights:
Possible Root Causes
Temporary Internal Faults
: The charger may have encountered a transient internal hardware or communication fault. These are often self-recoverable or recoverable through a power cycle
.
Control Processor Inoperability
: A black screen with red LEDs may indicate that the control processor failed to initialize correctly during startup. This can occur due to voltage fluctuations or internal sync issues.
Power Supply or Voltage Irregularities
: If the input voltage drops below the minimum threshold or fluctuates, the charger may shut down or enter a fault state.
Environmental or Overtemperature Conditions
: Overheating or blocked ventilation can cause the system to shut down as a protective measure.
Hope you satisfied with provided answer.
We thank you for your time and patience.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
